name: TimeScrubber
intent: A minimal, precise intraday timeline with bar / line / dots tracks, a playhead, and an optional two-handle range.
when: A surface reads a window of time rather than a single moment

commonMistakes.mistake: Re-picking which range handle to move on every pointer-move
commonMistakes.fix: Choose the handle on pointer-down and hold it for the gesture, clamping each end against its partner
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Hand the drag over mid-gesture when one end passes the other

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @corensystem/coren-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.

props.name: start
props.description: Range start (e.g. today 00:00).

props.name: end
props.description: Range end (e.g. today 24:00).

props.name: variant
props.description: How the data reads. Default "barGraph".

props.name: data
props.description: The series for bar/line tracks. For dots, points with `value > 0` become dots.

props.name: label
props.description: Left row-label chip, e.g. "Workers".

props.name: value
props.description: Cursor position (controlled). Scrubbing is enabled when `onValueChange` is given.

props.name: rangeValue
props.description: Selected range (controlled). Providing it puts a second handle on the track: drag either end, and the band between them is the selection. `value` stays the playhead, so a range and a cursor can coexist. Use it when the surface reads a window of time rather than a single moment.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest scrubbable/playable time — the cursor can't move past it (e.g. "now" on a live day).

props.name: minorEveryMinutes
props.description: Minutes between minor ticks. Default 60.

props.name: majorEveryMinutes
props.description: Minutes between labelled major ticks. Default 180.

props.name: sectionLabel
props.description: Header shown above the axis (e.g. the date). Ignored when `date` is set.

props.name: date
props.description: The day the axis covers. When `onDateChange` is given, the header becomes a date picker.

props.name: maxDate
props.description: Latest selectable day in the picker (future days are disabled). Default: today.

props.name: formatDate
props.description: Format the header date. Default "EEE, d MMM".

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Rendered next to the cursor time — e.g. the value at the cursor.

props.name: legend
props.description: Swatch legend shown in the header, for reading a stacked `segments` track. Keep it to a handful of entries — the header is a single row and competes with the date, controls and cursor readout.

props.name: playing
props.description: Playing state (controlled); the cursor advances by `playSpeed`.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Start the timeline collapsed to just the track (bars + cursor). Default false.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Collapsed state (controlled). Pair with `onCollapsedChange` when the surrounding layout reacts to it.

props.name: playSpeed
props.description: Simulated minutes advanced per real second while playing. Default 120.

props.name: showControls
props.description: Show the play/pause control. Default true when scrubbing is enabled.

props.name: formatTick
props.description: Format tick labels. Default HH:mm.

props.name: formatTime
props.description: Format the cursor readout. Default HH:mm.

props.name: height
props.description: Track height in px. Default 44.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element, merging props and behavior.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component is disabled.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

usage: Use TimeScrubber to enhance your user interface. This component provides a consistent, accessible, and well-designed solution for this use case.
TimeScrubber integrates seamlessly with other components in the design system. Follow the established patterns and guidelines to ensure consistency across your application.

anatomy.description: TimeScrubber is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Don't override core styles
bestPractices.description: Avoid using className to override the component's fundamental styling.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Handle all states
bestPractices.description: Account for loading, error, empty, and success states.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
bestPractices.description: Avoid showing broken UI when data is missing or loading.
